red_check.notes: Red read on the master at 2x-2.5x, sign by sign, independently of the plaintext alignment; red ى read as ي. Two red letters are ambiguous in form, not in sense: over row 2 sign 3 and row 3 sign 7 (both S3 lam-alif) the red is a closed loop without a dot, shaped like the red ه of الله, where the other two S3 glosses (row 3 sign 6, row 4 sign 8) are a dotted ن; counted as ن (the word needs ن, the cipher sign is the same S3), but it is a reading of the gloss, not a clean letter. Row 5 (صانع) carries no gloss. The short red stroke under row 4 sign 9 is below the line and not read.

verdict: key consistent: every repeated shape takes one letter, the red gloss agrees on all 39 glossed signs, and signs = letters = 43 with no surplus or drop. The only multi-shape letter is ل (S8 ring five times plus S5 solid dot once, in لارجو).
notes: Rows 2-5 of image 0084_0066. Signs by eye 13+12+14+4 = 43 (segmenter 44: on row 3 it boxes the S4 ayn as two pieces and the two lam-alifs as one box; on row 4 it agrees). Word groups: الظن and ما are written as one group of six signs (row 4, as the record says), and بجميل is split by the line end (ب alone after the last divider of row 3); otherwise one group per word. S2 is drawn with one tooth (most) or two teeth (row 2 sign 10, row 4 sign 11) or an upturned head (row 5 sign 2): taken as one shape because every instance is ا and the drawing varies continuously. S1 (و) and S11 (ت) both look like a 6 but differ in kind (S1 a large open loop, S11 a small hook on a straight stem); kept apart.
